name: PT Bumi Benowo Sukses Sejahtera Tbk
summary: PT Bumi Benowo Sukses Sejahtera Tbk engages in the construction of warehouses and shophouses. It sells and land, houses, apartments, offices, and other buildings, as well as rents warehouses. The company was formerly known as PT Firman Mercu Alam Film and changed its name to PT Bumi Benowo Sukses Sejahtera Tbk in October 2019. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Surabaya, Indonesia. PT Bumi Benowo Sukses Sejahtera Tbk operates as a subsidiary of Agung Alam Anugrah Group.
